## Plan

| Skill (type it as a slash command) | What it does | Produces |
|---|---|---|
| `/ai-feature-spec` | Specify a feature that uses an LLM or ML model - task definition, prompts, guardrails, evaluation, cost, latency, fallback, and human oversight. Use when the intent includes AI behavior. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/ai-feature.md` |
| `/aidlc-plan` | AIDLC Stage 1, Plan. Use to turn an idea, ticket, or incident finding into a committed intent.md (a proto-spec in the originator's own words) for the product owner to accept. | `intent.md` |
| `/backlog-prioritization` | Rank backlog items or intents with a transparent method (value, effort, risk, dependencies; MoSCoW or weighted scoring) and show the reasoning. Use for roadmap and sprint planning. | `docs/aidlc/planning/prioritization-<yyyymmdd>.md` |
| `/business-case` | Draft a concise business case (problem, options, benefits, costs, risks, recommendation) from an intent. Use when funding or prioritization needs a justification. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/business-case.md` |
| `/compliance-and-privacy-review` | Screen an intent or spec for regulated data and privacy obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, data residency) and route open questions to the right internal experts. Use at Plan, before design starts. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/compliance.md` |
| `/confluence-to-markdown` | Convert Confluence pages into Markdown references (requirements, standards, runbooks) with their links and version, so agents and reviewers can cite them. Use when a page feeds a spec or policy skill. | `docs/aidlc/references/<page-title>.md` |
| `/estimation-and-planning` | Produce a range-based estimate and delivery plan (milestones, dependencies, risks, assumptions) from the stories. Use when committing to scope and dates. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/delivery-plan.md` |
| `/generate-meeting-minutes` | Turn a transcript, recording notes, or chat log into structured meeting minutes with decisions, action items (owner and due date), risks, and open questions. Use after workshops, refinement sessions, and stakeholder meetings. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/minutes/<yyyymmdd>-<topic>.md` |
| `/grounded-research` | Research a topic from verifiable sources and report findings with citations, confidence, and clear separation of fact from inference. Use for market, domain, technology, or regulation questions before writing intent.md. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/research.md` |
| `/jira-to-markdown` | Convert Jira issues (epics, stories, bugs) into clean Markdown source files linked to the change, preserving fields, acceptance criteria, links, and comments. Use when a ticket should seed intent.md or be kept in the repository. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/sources/<KEY>.md` |
| `/requirements-gap-analysis` | Review requirements, stories, or an intent for gaps, ambiguity, conflicts, and missing non-functional needs, and list questions for the owner. Use before design starts. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/gap-analysis.md` |
| `/risk-assessment` | Identify and rate delivery, technical, security, compliance, and operational risks with mitigations and owners. Use during Plan and refresh at each gate. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/risks.md` |
| `/stakeholder-analysis` | Identify stakeholders, their interests, influence, and expectations, and propose an engagement and communication approach. Use at the start of a change or when ownership is unclear. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/stakeholders.md` |
| `/user-stories-and-acceptance-criteria` | Write user stories with testable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria from intent.md or a ticket, sliced small enough to build in a few days. Use when refining the backlog. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/stories.md` |

## Design

| Skill (type it as a slash command) | What it does | Produces |
|---|---|---|
| `/aidlc-design` | AIDLC Stage 2, Design. Use to turn an accepted intent.md into a requirements-and-design spec.md in one session, constrained by the organization's policy skills, with concerns flagged for the product owner. | `spec.md` |
| `/api-design` | Design an API contract-first (resources, operations, errors, versioning, security) and produce an OpenAPI or schema draft. Use before implementing services or integrations. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/api-spec.md` |
| `/architecture-decision-record` | Capture a significant technical decision as an ADR with context, options, decision, and consequences. Use whenever a choice is costly to reverse. | `docs/aidlc/decisions/ADR-<number>-<slug>.md` |
| `/data-modeling` | Design the data model (entities, relationships, keys, constraints, retention, classification) and the migration approach. Use when a change adds or alters stored data. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/data-model.md` |
| `/design-review` | Review a spec or architecture against requirements, policies, and good practice, and return ranked findings. Use before a spec is accepted. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/design-review.md` |
| `/integration-design` | Design asynchronous and system-to-system integrations - events, queues, file transfers, contracts, retries, idempotency, ordering, and failure handling. Use when two or more systems must exchange data. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/integration.md` |
| `/nfr-capacity-planning` | Define measurable non-functional requirements (performance, availability, scalability, security, accessibility) and a capacity estimate. Use when a design must meet service levels. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/nfr.md` |
| `/platform-design` | Design the cloud or on-premises platform a solution runs on - landing zone, network, identity, environments, shared services, and guardrails. Use when a change needs new or changed platform foundations. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/platform.md` |
| `/solution-architecture` | Produce a solution architecture (context, containers, components) with Mermaid diagrams, technology choices, and quality attributes for an accepted intent. Use in Design. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/architecture.md` |
| `/threat-modeling` | Identify threats to a design with a structured method (for example STRIDE), rate them, and propose mitigations and tests. Use before building anything that handles data, identity, or external input. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/threat-model.md` |
| `/ui-ux-spec` | Specify screens, flows, states, content, and accessibility for a user-facing change, referencing designs from the design tool. Use for front-end work. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/ux-spec.md` |

| `/dependency-upgrade` | Upgrade a dependency or framework safely - read release notes, change in small steps, run tests, and report breaking changes. Use when the plan includes an upgrade. | the diff and a short upgrade note |
| `/framework-upgrade` | Upgrade a language runtime or framework across major versions (for example Java, .NET, Angular, Node, Python) in safe, testable steps. Use when the change is bigger than a dependency bump. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/upgrade-plan.md` and a series of small pull requests |
| `/impact-analysis` | Determine what a proposed change affects - code, data, interfaces, consumers, tests, documentation, and operations, with a risk rating. Use before writing plan.md for brownfield work. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/impact-analysis.md` |
| `/knowledge-graph` | Build a graph of modules, services, data stores, APIs, teams, and their dependencies from code and configuration, as JSON plus a Mermaid view. Use for architecture comprehension, impact analysis, and onboarding. | `docs/aidlc/knowledge/graph.json and graph.md` |

| `/legacy-modernization` | Plan the modernization of a legacy application or mainframe workload - disposition per component (retain, rehost, replatform, refactor, replace, retire), sequencing, coexistence, and risk. Use after legacy analysis. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/modernization.md` |
| `/refactoring` | Refactor code in small, behavior-preserving steps protected by tests. Use when the plan calls for restructuring. | the diff and `plan.md` updates |
| `/secrets-and-config-management` | Find hard-coded secrets and design how secrets and configuration are stored, injected, rotated, and audited. Use when code or pipelines handle credentials, keys, or environment configuration. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/secrets-config.md` |
| `/tech-debt-assessment` | Find and rank technical debt (complexity, duplication, missing tests, outdated frameworks, fragile areas) with evidence and a remediation order. Use to plan refactoring and justify it. | `docs/aidlc/analysis/tech-debt.md` |

| Skill (type it as a slash command) | What it does | Produces |
|---|---|---|

| `/aidlc-test` | AIDLC Stage 4, Test. Use to give the agent a feedback loop so it verifies its own work (tests, build, visual check), to fix bugs test-first, and to produce test-report.md evidence before a human reviews. | `test-report.md` |
| `/contract-testing` | Write consumer-driven or schema-based contract tests so services and clients can change independently without breaking each other. Use for APIs, events, and message integrations. | contract tests and `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/contracts.md` |
| `/coverage-gap-analysis` | Compare tests to requirements and code to find untested behavior and risky untested paths. Use to decide where to add tests. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/coverage-gaps.md` |
| `/defect-triage` | Reproduce, classify, and prioritize defects, write clear reports with steps and evidence, and link them to requirements. Use during and after testing. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/defects.md` |
| `/e2e-test-authoring` | Author stable end-to-end tests for the critical user journeys, with resilient selectors, test data setup, and clear failure output. Use for UI and full-flow checks. | test files in the diff |
| `/mutation-testing` | Measure how well tests detect defects by mutating code and checking the suite fails, then strengthen weak tests. Use to validate AI-generated or high-risk tests. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/mutation-report.md` |
| `/performance-test` | Design and analyze load, stress, and endurance tests against the non-functional targets, and report bottlenecks. Use when targets are defined. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/performance-report.md` |
| `/security-scan-review` | Run and triage static analysis, dependency, secret, and container scans; separate real findings from noise and propose fixes. Use before release. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/security-findings.md` |
| `/test-data-generation` | Generate realistic but synthetic test data that respects constraints and covers edge cases, without personal or production data. Use when tests need data. | test fixtures in the diff |
| `/test-strategy` | Define a risk-based test strategy (levels, scope, environments, data, entry and exit criteria) for a change. Use at the start of Test or during planning. | `docs/aidlc/changes/<id>/test-strategy.md` |
| `/unit-test-generation` | Generate meaningful unit tests for changed code covering behavior, edge cases, and failure paths, in the project's test style. Use alongside implementation. | test files in the diff |

## Git and GitHub

| Skill (type it as a slash command) | What it does | Produces |
|---|---|---|
| `/git-commit` | Create a branch and well-formed commits. Use when asked to commit changes, create a feature branch, or write a commit message following Conventional Commits. | a branch and commits |
| `/git-create-pr` | Raise a pull request with a clear title, description, and an initial comment. Use when asked to create, open, or raise a PR (GitHub via gh CLI; Azure DevOps via az repos). | a pull request |
| `/git-pr-comment` | Add, reply to, and resolve comments on a pull request, including summary comments and inline code comments. Use when asked to comment on a PR, answer review feedback, or address reviewer comments. | comments and replies |
| `/git-release-notes` | Generate release notes and a changelog entry from commits and merged PRs, and optionally tag and publish a release. Use when asked for release notes, a changelog, or to cut a release. | `CHANGELOG.md`, tag, release |
| `/git-resolve-pr-conflicts` | Sync a branch with its base and resolve merge or rebase conflicts, including conflicts on a GitHub or Azure DevOps pull request. Use when a branch is behind, a PR says it has conflicts or cannot be merged, or the user asks to rebase, merge, sync, or fix merge conflicts. | a conflict-free branch |
| `/git-review-pr` | Review a pull request for correctness, security, tests, and requirement coverage, then optionally submit the review. Use when asked to review a PR by number, URL, or branch. | a review on the pull request |

|---|---|---|
| `/aidlc-connectors` | Use connectors (MCP servers for Git, Figma, Jira, Confluence, and company-specific systems) at each AIDLC stage, set them up safely, and keep tickets, pages, designs, and the repository consistent. | `/aidlc-evals` | Build and run continuous evals, the AIDLC equivalent of stage-gate QA, so changes to agent configuration (project context, skills, agents, guard rules) or to the underlying model are regression-tested like code. | `evals/` files |

| `/aidlc-policy-skill` | Write an organization policy as a skill (security standard, API convention, brand rule, compliance control) so agents apply institutional knowledge consistently. Use when a rule is enforced inconsistently today. | a policy skill |
| `/aidlc-project-context` | Create and maintain AGENTS.md, the project context file that gives every agent the knowledge a new joiner needs (commands, conventions, architecture, common mistakes). Use when setting up a repo for AIDLC or when an agent repeats a mistake. | `AGENTS.md` |
| `/aidlc-review-policy` | Write and tune REVIEW.md, the review policy that every AI review pass follows (passes, what counts as Important versus Nit, caps, exclusions). Use when setting up PR review or when review noise is high. | `REVIEW.md` |
| `/aidlc-workflow` | AIDLC orchestrator. Use to start a change, see which stage each change is in, find the next gate, or decide which stage skill to run (plan, design, build, test, deploy, maintain). | `docs/aidlc/status.md` (tracker) |

## Agents

An agent is a focused helper with its own context and a limited set of tools. A skill tells the assistant **how to do a job**; an agent is **who does a bounded part of it** without seeing, or being able to change, more than it needs. The main assistant session calls agents; agents do not call each other.

| Agent | Group | Tools | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code-simplifier` | Build | read, search, edit, execute | Strips needless complexity from a finished change without altering behavior. Use after the main implementation passes its checks and before the pull request is raised. |
| `confidence-gate` | Maintain | read, search, execute | Adversarial independent check between headless stages. Challenges the previous stage's output and decides whether it continues or escalates to a human. Use in automated loops. |
| `documentation-agent` | Build | read, search, edit, execute | Keeps documentation in step with the code after a change - README, AGENTS.md, ADRs, API docs, runbooks, and onboarding notes - and proposes the edits as a pull request. Use after a build or release is merged, or when docs are suspected stale. Edits documentation only. |
| `incident-diagnostician` | Maintain | read, search, execute | Diagnoses a control-band breach or incident read-only and writes the finding as incident.md plus a new intent.md. Use in Maintain when a trigger fires at 2 sigma or above. |
| `intent-analyst` | Plan | read, search, edit | Interviews an originator and drafts intent.md. Use at the start of Plan, when someone has an idea, a ticket, or an incident finding to capture. |
| `planner` | Build | read, search | Read-only planner. Reads the codebase and the accepted spec.md and proposes plan.md (files, order of work, risks, proof). Use at the start of Build, before any code is written. |
| `release-coordinator` | Deploy | read, search, edit, execute | Prepares a release up to the production gate (checklist, rollout plan, rollback plan, release notes) and never past it. Use in Deploy once the PR is merged and checks are green. |
| `researcher` | Build | read, search | Explores the codebase read-only and reports a concise answer without flooding the main context. Use when a task needs to find how something works, where it is used, or what a change would touch. |
| `reviewer` | Deploy | read, search, execute | Reviews a pull request in layered passes (bugs, security, compliance with spec.md, plan.md, and the language coding standards in docs/aidlc/standards) under REVIEW.md and returns ranked findings that cite rule IDs. Use on every PR. Cannot approve or edit. |
| `security-reviewer` | Deploy | read, search, execute | Reviews a change for security and privacy risk in a dedicated pass - injection, authentication and authorization, secrets, personal data handling, dependency and license issues, and unsafe configuration - and returns ranked findings. Use on every PR that touches auth, data, config, dependencies, or infrastructure. Cannot approve or edit. |
| `spec-author` | Design | read, search, edit | Turns an accepted intent.md into spec.md (requirements and design in one session) constrained by the organization's policy skills, with concerns flagged. Use in Design. |
| `verifier` | Test | read, execute | Runs the app and the checks in a fresh context and reports whether the change works as plan.md says, before the session reports done. Reports only; never fixes. |

**Tools key:** `read` read files; `search` search the code; `edit` change files; `execute` run commands. An agent with only `read, search` cannot change anything.

## Role presets

The picker on the Installation page installs these sets. Edit them in `catalog/catalog.json`.

| Role | Description | Whole groups | Extra skills |
|---|---|---|---|
| Everything | All skills and agents | Plan, Design, Build, Test, Deploy, Maintain, Git and GitHub, Foundations | — |
| Business analyst | Plan skills plus UX and design review, connectors | Plan | `ui-ux-spec`, `design-review`, `aidlc-connectors`, `aidlc-metrics` |
| Architect | Design skills, analysis, and guardrails | Design | `aidlc-analysis`, `analyze-repository`, `impact-analysis`, `knowledge-index`, `knowledge-graph`, `aidlc-policy-skill`, `aidlc-guardrails`, `aidlc-connectors` |
| Developer | Build skills, Git and GitHub, project context | Build, Git and GitHub | `aidlc-project-context`, `aidlc-connectors`, `code-review` |
| Mainframe developer | COBOL development and analysis, code review, Git, and the analysis skills | — | `cobol-development`, `cobol-legacy-analysis`, `code-review`, `aidlc-build`, `analyze-repository`, `impact-analysis`, `knowledge-index`, `knowledge-graph`, `test-strategy`, `defect-triage`, `change-request`, `aidlc-project-context`, `aidlc-connectors`, `git-commit`, `git-create-pr`, `git-review-pr`, `git-pr-comment`, `git-resolve-pr-conflicts` |
| Tester | Test skills, defects, evals | Test | `aidlc-evals`, `git-create-pr`, `git-pr-comment`, `aidlc-connectors`, `code-review` |
| DevOps and release | Deploy and Maintain skills, guardrails, Git | Deploy, Maintain, Git and GitHub | `aidlc-guardrails`, `aidlc-review-policy`, `aidlc-connectors`, `code-review` |
| Support and operations | Maintain skills and connectors | Maintain | `aidlc-connectors`, `aidlc-metrics` |

The orchestrator (`aidlc-workflow`) is always installed.
